entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (ASPA, an enzyme). Most pathogenic missense variants of this enzyme are low-abundance in HEK293T: 50 of 61 pathogenic variants score below 0.5.
entries.snippet: Conversely, 50 out of 61 pathogenic variants displayed an abundance score lower than 0.5 (Fig. 6A).
entries.anchor: Results, Most disease-linked ASPA variants have reduced abundance, paragraph 1

experimental_context.genotype: ASPA missense and nonsense variants (about 98 percent of 6,260 possible); no WWOX
experimental_context.endpoint: GFP:mCherry abundance score, toxicity score (growth slope), flow profiles under perturbation
